race.comment: WINDSOR CHARIOT (8) is a gelding by Circus Maximus on debut for the Hayes yard. He's a stoutly bred type who will likely get over further but looks talented enough to win this first time out, late betting will be key. MORE FOXIE (4) ran well on debut at Sale when in the market and finding the line well for third. He should improve off that and take beating from the soft gate. DIESEL DESMOND (1) is racing consistently and rates an each way chance, first go synthetic but he had excuses last time. SHINY DIAMOND (12) has been fair in two runs back and could improve, don't mind the switch to synthetic for her.
